incompleteWeek.note: Trailing UTC week with fewer than 7 days; excluded from headline KPIs and complete series charts.

meta.uiHint: Prefer kpis + token/revenue for provider Token/Revenue; use appsWeekly/contextMix/taskMix7d/programmingShare/sessionCost/catalogDerived as additive panels.
meta.refresh: Follow OpenRouter rankings-daily UTC day: rebuild after each new UTC day; re-fetch appsWeekly/contextMix/programmingShare for latest complete week; taskMix7d + sessionCost + catalogDerived are snapshots (trailing/weekly/catalog).

appsWeekly.trendingNote: Trending #1 (excess growth vs prior equal windows): Portkey AI (3.07T tokens in window).
caveats: Public apps marketplace only; hidden/private apps excluded; aliases merged.
Tokenizers differ by upstream provider; cross-app token compares are approximate.
trending uses excess growth vs three prior equal-length windows; may return <limit.
Exact context_bucket slices (1K/10K/100K/1M/10M); cannot combine with category/language_type.
Each slice is top-50 models + other within that bucket; shares are among returned bucket totals.
Sum of buckets may not equal all-site headline tokens (coverage / ranking truncation).
Sampled classifications; absolute volumes not exposed — shares of classified traffic only.
Unclassified 'other' excluded from denominator; shares sum to ~1 across classifications.
Trailing 7d window (not necessarily Mon–Sun complete week); only window=7d supported.
language_type uses sampled/upsampled weekly-grain estimates; not exact day totals.
Cannot combine language_type with context_bucket/category/modality; period=day rejected.
Provider mapping matches replicate author-prefix rules (DeepSeek/OpenAI/…/Other).
allSite here is period=week unfiltered rankings-daily for same window (may differ slightly from headline kpis.tokens_T grain).

coverage.note: Published harnesses only; sessions never pooled across apps; privacy-preserving medians; weekly refresh.

sessionCost.citation: Source: OpenRouter Data API (openrouter.ai/docs/cookbook/administration/data-api), as of 2026-11-09T06:00:07.912Z.
caveats: Not all apps/models; only published harness cells with enough privacy mass.
Medians of per-session USD; not means; not platform-wide ARPU.
Window typically ~30d ending window_end_date; independent of Mon–Sun rankings week.
limit=200 may truncate long tail; use offset for more if needed.

cachePricing.note: Catalog list pricing only; ratio = input_cache_read / prompt when both present. Not traffic-weighted.

caveats: Light catalog metrics from GET /api/v1/models snapshot; not usage-weighted.
hugging_face_id nonempty ≈ open-weight listing hint, not a legal OSS claim.
`:free` suffix count ≠ free traffic share.

gpuRentalIndex.sourceNote: Rolling window ~30d. Cumulative history: history_all.json / gpu_rental_history.jsonl
